interface.title: Pakistan land cover and carbon, 1993-2023 (Streamlit app, pakistan-lulc-carbon)
interface.field: Remote sensing / land-use and land-cover change / terrestrial carbon accounting
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis and interpretation of precomputed land-cover statistics, and checking figures before citing them
interface.what_it_is_for: Choose a Pakistani region and a pair of years, then read the built-up and vegetation change and the carbon stock and flux those land-cover changes imply, with uncertainty bands, the full arithmetic behind each figure, a ranking of all districts and the method's stated limits.

data.note: The app reads cached GLC-FCS30D area and transition tables that ship with the repository (cache/*.json). Earth Engine credentials are missing, so the app runs from cache only. The Map tab is disabled by design and every other tab works. Epochs are 1995, 2003, 2013 and 2022, labelled as 1993, 2003, 2013 and 2023.

tree.general: Measure how land cover changed in a region between two dates, estimate the carbon those changes imply, and judge how far the figures can be trusted
tree.specific: For Pakistan, a province or a district, read built-up and vegetation change and carbon flux for a year-pair from GLC-FCS30D, check the 1995/2000 seam artefact and the uncertainty band, inspect the arithmetic, rank districts and read the caveats

features.name: Region → sub-unit cascading selector
features.general: Pick a top-level area, then optionally narrow to a sub-unit. Every view recomputes for the selection. Areas with no sub-units say so instead of offering an empty list.
features.specific: Region combobox (Pakistan / 8 provinces and territories). Choosing a province adds a District combobox with '(whole territory)' as default. Gilgit-Baltistan and Azad Kashmir show a note that they have no districts. The sidebar footer shows the region's area.
steps: open Region and type to filter
choose a District, or leave '(whole territory)'
read any tab, now titled with the chosen unit
serves_tasks: Pick a national, province-level or district-level area

features.name: Epoch-pair selector with discontinuity warning
features.general: Choose which two dates to compare. Pairs that cross a known break between data products are labelled and warned about, and a break-free baseline is the default.
features.specific: Comparison dropdown whose labels mark seam crossings ('— crosses seam' / '— seam-free'). A sidebar ⚠ note and a red banner in Change and carbon appear for 1995-based pairs. The Districts heading and the CSV file name follow the pair.
steps: choose a seam-crossing pair and read the warning
compare the headline deltas between the two
serves_tasks: Separate apparent change caused by joining two data products from real change
Pick the pair of dates to compare

features.name: Headline change tiles with uncertainty-sign check
features.general: Show key totals with their change since the earlier date, give the low-high range and gross components, and warn automatically when the range includes zero, so the sign cannot be claimed.
features.specific: Four metric tiles (Built-up area, Vegetation area, Carbon stock, Net carbon flux in Tg C and CO₂e) with a line giving the uncertainty band and gross loss/gain. A yellow 'sign of the net carbon flux is not established' callout appears when the band spans zero. A blue callout gives the share of loss from the permanent-ice class and the net flux with it excluded. Known bug, do not copy: the sign callout under 'Carbon lost to built-up expansion' negates and swaps the band (shows −41.8 to 6.0 for a stated 6.01 to 41.82 Tg C) and so fires when the range does not include zero.
steps: read the low-high band and gross loss/gain
read the sign-check and ice callouts
serves_tasks: Quantify carbon stock, gross loss, gross gain and net flux with their uncertainty
Attribute carbon loss to one kind of conversion, set it against all loss of that cover, and flag classes that distort the result

features.name: From-to transition Sankey with conversion impact bars
features.general: Show how area moved between categories from one date to another with unchanged area left out, then rank the conversions by their effect on a derived quantity.
features.specific: Plotly Sankey 'Land converted between X and Y (persistence excluded)' over four classes, with hover showing km² per band and a caption giving the share changed. Below it, a diverging bar chart 'Largest carbon changes by conversion' in Tg C.
steps: hover a band to read its from→to area
read the caption for the share of area that changed
read the ranked carbon bars for the biggest losses and gains
serves_tasks: See which class-to-class conversions moved the most area and carbon

features.name: Worked-arithmetic panel
features.general: Lay out every step that turns raw counts into a headline number, using the actual values for the current selection: extraction code, parameter table, area × factor sums, change formula and full transition table.
features.specific: Show the arithmetic tab: Step 1 (Earth Engine reduceRegion code and expander), Step 2 (density table, one best value per pool with low/best/high totals, and a Tier 1 warning), Step 3 (ha × Mg C/ha = Tg C per class), Step 4 (ΔC = A(ρt−ρf) for the 12 largest losses plus gross/net), Step 5 (uncorrected vs corrected factor), and the expandable 'Full conversion table'.
steps: read the stock and flux sums
serves_tasks: Inspect the data reduction and the per-class carbon density table
Follow area-times-density sums and the from-to flux formula with real numbers

scroll the epoch table sideways for low/best/high

features.name: Method caveats and provenance panel
features.general: Before a figure is cited, set out the known breaks in the record, the dates actually used versus those requested, the spatial extent and its disputed parts, class and parameter caveats, what the analysis is not, and a machine-readable provenance record.
features.specific: Method and limits tab: seam discontinuity table (e.g. Lahore 234→389 km², +66% at 1995→2000), requested vs used epochs (1993→1995, 2023→2022), geoBoundaries extent with AJK/GB as disputed, ice-is-snow table, Tier 1 placeholder densities, 'What this is not', provenance JSON.
steps: read requested vs used epochs and the extent notes
